en: The image shows a colorized vintage postcard depicting a street scene with people walking in front of well-preserved late 19th or early 20th century multi-story buildings. A sign advertises 'Otto Kahn' on the corner building. The street is paved and there are awnings over some of the shop windows. The text at the top reads 'Zwoenitz i. Erzgeb. Innere Bahnhofstraße.' in German.
